description: Have ANAF render an invoice as its official PDF and save it to the downloads outbox. Give message_id (from list_invoices) for a filed invoice, or a UBL document as xml ({ path } for a file, or { content_base64, sha256 } from a script). A filed invoice is not validated again; a document is validated first unless validate is false, and when it fails nothing is saved and findings say why. Returns saved, path, bytes and sha256 of the PDF. The PDF itself needs no grant; fetching a filed invoice by message_id does.

message_id.description: The id field from list_invoices (digits), not requestId.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-09"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

test.description: For message_id only: fetch it from ANAF's test environment.

validate.description: For a document only: validate before converting.

xml.description: A UBL invoice or credit note: { path } or { content_base64, sha256 }. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes as standard base64, as a script that read the file wrote them. Needs sha256.

path.description: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-hea_52fe); a bare name is taken from the first; or a file this server saved in its outbox, by the path it answered. Read byte for byte.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it: required with content_base64, checked with path. A mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is sent.

name: invoice_pdf
title: Render an invoice as ANAF's PDF
